clips.title: The story
paras: Cenarius, the Lord of the Forest, is the ancient demigod son of Elune and Malorne who taught the night elves the secrets of druidism. For thousands of years he served as the great patron of mortal druids and guardian of the wilderness before falling in battle during the Third War.

Cenarius was born to Elune, the goddess of the moon, and the great white stag demigod Malorne. Because Cenarius was bound to the mortal world, Elune placed him in the care of Malorne, while Ysera the Dreamer embraced him as a foster mother and guided him through the infinite paths of the Emerald Dream. Blessed with powers over living wood and earth, Cenarius fathered the Keepers of the Grove and the dryads, forever tying his bloodline to the wild places of Kalimdor.
